other.content: Label on backing, in artist's hand: No. 37 ELI / Chicken in Sunrise / 1917 / Watercolor (Source: MAM, 2025)

materials.content:
Watercolor on moderately thick, cream, smooth wove paper with a slightly fuzzy feel
(Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

cr_data.provenance:
[1] By February 25, 1958, (The Downtown Gallery, New York, New York, USA); [2] June 28, 1960, purchased by Allen-Bradley Co. (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA); [3] June 1969, gift to The Bradley Family Foundation (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA); 1977, gift to Milwaukee Art Center (Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA) 
NOTES: 
[1] Downtown Gallery, Georgia O’Keeffe: Watercolors, 1916–17 (New York: The Downtown Gallery, 1958), cat. 37. 
[2] Invoice addressed to The Allen-Bradley Company in MAM object file, marked paid by “AB” in July 1960. See also Barbara Buhler Lynes, Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. Vol. 1 (New Haven: Yale University Press, 1999), p. 105, cat. 175. 
[3] Documentation from The Bradley Family Foundation in MAM object file. See also Barbara Buhler Lynes, Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. Vol. 1 (New Haven: Yale University Press, 1999), p. 105, cat. 175. 
(Source: MAM, 2025)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert." Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 21. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
